name: COFOG functional classification
description: United Nations Classification of the Functions of Government, divisions (first level). This is what makes budgets comparable across countries: administrative structures differ everywhere, but 'how much goes to health' is answerable anywhere. COFOG has three levels; only the ten divisions are enumerated here, and publishers may use full group and class codes such as 07.3 or 07.3.1 as the value.

hasDefinedTerm.name: General public services
hasDefinedTerm.description: Executive and legislative organs, financial and fiscal affairs, external affairs, public debt transactions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public order and safety
hasDefinedTerm.description: Police, fire protection, law courts, prisons.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Economic affairs
hasDefinedTerm.description: Transport, agriculture, fuel and energy, communication, general economic and labour affairs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Environmental protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Waste and wastewater management, pollution abatement, biodiversity.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Housing and community amenities
hasDefinedTerm.description: Housing development, community development, water supply, street lighting.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Recreation, culture and religion
hasDefinedTerm.description: Recreational and sporting services, cultural services, broadcasting.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Social protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sickness and disability, old age, family and children, unemployment, housing support.
